observability.observation_contract: At most one attempt per unchanged head/receipt/blocker; every action or delegation is attributable to the exact head and bounded receipt.

orphan_policy: Any autonomous actor without a registered parent, reporting path, purpose, current reason, bounded failure policy, allowed mutations, wake/retirement conditions and observation contract is a governance failure.
terminal_policy: No actor may create successor work merely to remain active. Construction terminates at STABLE when no currently justified work exists.
